sentences.en: Conclusion The hemisection can get satisfactory effect to repair the first mandibular molar with distal tooth reservated by selecting suitable tooth.

sentences.en: Conclusions. Functional recovery after hemisection injury improved significantly in the late postoperative period with transplantation of preconditioned peripheral nerve.

sentences.en: Objective To observe the effects of microencapsulated rabbit sciatic nerve tissue transplantation on substance P(SP) expression in dorsal root ganglia(DRG) after spinal cord hemisection injury (hSCI).
